# UI/UX Pro Max

- Establish clear visual hierarchy: one primary action per view, consistent spacing scale (4/8px multiples).
- Use a limited palette with design tokens (CSS variables); ensure WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1 text).
- Typography: max 2 font families, readable line length (45–75 chars), line-height 1.4–1.6.
- Mobile-first responsive layouts; touch targets >= 44px.
- Provide hover, focus-visible, active, disabled, loading, empty and error states.
- Support keyboard navigation, semantic HTML, alt text and prefers-reduced-motion.
- Use skeleton loaders and lazy-loaded images for perceived performance.
- Keep the existing site design language in site/public unless asked to change it.
